name: c1-proxy
description: C1 Proxy — modular self-hosted edge proxy control plane for Cloudflare Workers

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run

DB.description: C1 primary D1 database. Cloudflare provisions it automatically for Deploy to Cloudflare.

KV.description: C1 cache and rate-limit KV namespace. Cloudflare provisions it automatically.

C1_CLAIM_TOKEN.description: Recommended install secret. Generate a random value (for example `openssl rand -hex 16`). You will enter it once on the first-install screen.

C1_SESSION_SECRET.description: Optional session signing secret. Generate a random value (for example `openssl rand -hex 32`). If omitted, C1 generates and stores one in D1 on first use.
